title: Beyond city pairs: Higher-order information in urban growth across borders
abstract: arXiv:2610.31159v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We apply higher-order information measures to urban growth across borders and spatial units. We analyse 8,808 functional urban areas using gridded GDP estimates allocated from national accounts. Negative estimated O-information occurs in 29.93% of cross-border triplets and 2.00% of domestic triplets. This fifteen-fold contrast falls to fourfold at comparable dependence strength and persists under data-quality restrictions. Target-specific decompositions show how information overlaps or combines across cities. Administrative subdivisions have mean O-information within matched random-map ranges inside countries. These findings show why interpreting geographic dependence requires specifying comparison cities and spatial units, while economic connections remain to be established independently.

translated_title: 超越城市对：跨境城市增长中的高阶信息
translated_abstract: 我们将高阶信息度量应用于跨境及不同空间单元的城市增长分析。我们利用从国民经济核算中分配的网格化GDP估计数据，分析了8,808个功能性城市区域。负的估计O信息出现在29.93%的跨境城市三元组和2.00%的国内城市三元组中。在可比的依赖强度下，这一15倍的对比降至4倍，并且在数据质量限制条件下依然存在。针对特定目标的分解显示了信息如何在城市之间重叠或结合。在各国内部，行政区划的平均O信息处于匹配随机地图的范围内。这些发现表明，解释地理依赖性时必须明确所比较的城市和空间单元，而经济联系则仍有待独立验证。
tldr: 该研究利用高阶信息度量分析8,808个功能性城市区域，发现跨境城市三元组中出现负O信息的比例（29.93%）约为国内三元组（2.00%）的15倍，表明解释地理依赖性必须明确所比较的城市与空间单元。
en_tdlr: Applying higher-order information measures to 8,808 functional urban areas, this study finds negative O-information occurs about 15 times more often in cross-border city triplets (29.93%) than domestic ones (2.00%), showing that interpreting geographic dependence requires specifying comparison cities and spatial units.
